# File: monster_speech.txt
#
# What a monster with the CAN_SPEAK flag says (ZangbandTK, CNT-04).
#
# Zangband kept these in lib/file as monspeak.txt, monfear.txt, mondeath.txt and
# crime.txt, each keyed by the monster's index in r_info.txt.  Those indices mean
# nothing here -- this game's monsters are matched by name and its bestiary is a
# different size -- so what is carried over is the wildcard section each of those
# files ended with: the lines any speaker could use.  Per-monster lines are a
# later job and want a key that survives the import.
#
# Fields:
#   speak: - said in a fight, in sight of the player
#   fear:  - said instead when the monster is afraid and running
#   death: - said when it dies
#   crime: - what a unique turns out to have been wanted for, when a bounty is
#            collected on its corpse
#
# The text is Zangband's own.  Three crimes were dropped rather than carried:
#   rape; rape, assault and battery; rape and pillage
